events.title: Tupac Shakur Remembered
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, the influential rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, tragically passing away days later. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering a true icon of hip-hop today. Tupac Shakur's music and message continue to resonate decades on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Remembered
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: On this day, we pay tribute to the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His influence on music is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock legend still delivering the hits.

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the legendary Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Rock'n'Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: Imagine Single Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon's powerful message of peace, 'Imagine', first hit the airwaves. A song that truly transcends generations.

events.title: The iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Tech Game Changer
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got your hands on an iPod? Twenty-five years today since Apple launched the device that changed our music habits.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Birthday Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the extraordinary life and music of John Lennon. His legacy lives on.

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The White Album Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years today since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sounds incredible.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, we remember the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: Thirty-five years today since we lost the magnificent Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: Rubber Soul Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. An album that marked a pivotal moment in their evolution.
